title: Wan Renwang and the fortune-teller
summary: Jin Ping'er fights Fa Shan of Tian Yin Temple, Xiao Yicai and Yan Hong of Fen Xiang Valley, amused that three sects are after the same artefact. On the road Zhou Yixian meets the Ghost King, an old acquaintance; the Ghost King recalls that Zhou Yixian once read his stars and foretold he would lose his wife and child, which came true. Zhou Yixian confesses he knew nothing of star reading and made it up because the young man was arrogant; the Ghost King tells Xiao Huan to call him Wan Renwang. Qing Long and Zhu Que ask why their arrival is hidden from Gui Li, and the Ghost King says Gui Li mastered the Heavenly Book in ten years instead of thirty. Lu Xueqi meets Gui Li, asks why he risked himself for her at Jade Purity Hall ten years ago, and begs Junior Zhang to come back; he says he has not used that name for a long time and cannot return. Qing Long and Zhu Que plan to trap the Yellow Bird, a Nine Heavens spirit bird expected with the golden light, with the Four Spirits Blood Formation, though Qing Long thinks the formation too cruel and says the Ghost King changed after Bi Yao's death. The disciples find a giant ancient tree whose roots form walls and climb it in search of the relic.
